The Cross-Signal Intelligence Engine

# From Raw Signals to Predictive Market Intelligence

Other platforms give you data from one source. We correlate signals across app stores, ad networks, streaming platforms, and user behavior to produce intelligence no single source can match — then layer AI predictions on top.

## Why cross-signal?

Single-source data tells you what happened. Cross-signal intelligence tells you why — and what happens next.

A download spike is just a number until you can see the ad campaign that caused it, the keyword rank change that amplified it, the streaming surge that preceded it, and the review sentiment shift that followed. That's what cross-signal correlation delivers.

We ingest data from app store APIs, ad network libraries, Steam Web API, streaming platforms, APK analysis, and user review feeds — then normalize, cross-reference, and layer AI predictions to produce intelligence that's greater than the sum of its parts.

App Store Data

Downloads, revenue, rankings, metadata, reviews from Google Play & Apple App Store

Ad Network Data

Creative tracking, spend estimates, network distribution from Meta, TikTok, Google, Unity, AppLovin

Steam & PC Data

Player counts, price history, achievements, community activity from Steam Web API

Streaming Data

Twitch viewership, YouTube gaming metrics, streamer activity correlation with downloads

APK Analysis

SDK detection, technology stack identification, game engine fingerprinting from binary analysis

NLP & Sentiment

AI-powered review analysis across 30+ languages, feature extraction, sentiment trending

## Under the hood

The Intelligence Engine

This isn't a dashboard on top of a database. It's a purpose-built intelligence engine with six layers of data processing that turn raw signals into forward-looking market intelligence.

### Cross-Signal Correlation

We don't just aggregate data — we correlate signals across sources. A download spike means more when you can see the ad campaign that caused it, the keyword rank change that amplified it, and the streaming surge that preceded it.

### Geo-Adjusted Normalization

Raw numbers from different markets aren't comparable without normalization. Our models adjust for market size, purchasing power, platform distribution, and seasonal patterns across 140 countries — so every comparison is honest.

### Temporal Pattern Modeling

We model time-series behavior for every tracked title: weekly seasonality, update impact windows, competitor launch effects, and long-term lifecycle curves. This is what makes our anomaly detection and forecasting accurate — we understand what 'normal' looks like.

### Ensemble Prediction Architecture

Our prediction engine isn't a single model. It's an ensemble of gradient-boosted trees for tabular features, transformer models for sequential patterns, and collaborative filtering for similarity-based inference — retrained weekly on fresh data.

### Signal Confidence Weighting

Not all data is equally reliable. Our models assign confidence weights to each signal source based on freshness, coverage, and historical accuracy. Higher-confidence signals carry more weight in predictions, and every output includes uncertainty ranges.

### Continuous Backtesting

Every prediction model is continuously backtested against holdout data and, where available, publisher-reported actuals. We publish accuracy metrics transparently: median retention prediction error below 15% at D30 horizon, revenue forecasts within 20% at 90-day horizon.

## How we compare

Built to replace a stack of tools

Most intelligence platforms cover one vertical well. AllInsights.ai correlates signals across all of them.

| Platform | Category | Limitation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sensor Tower | Mobile analytics | Single-platform focus, no PC/console, limited predictive capabilities |
| Data.ai | Mobile intelligence | Mobile-only, no cross-platform franchise tracking, no AI Copilot |
| SteamDB | Steam data | PC-only, no mobile data, no ad intelligence, no predictions |
| SimilarWeb | Web analytics | Web-centric, limited app depth, no game-specific intelligence |
| AppMagic | Mobile market data | Data-only, no predictive layer, no sentiment analysis, no SDK detection |
| AllInsights.ai | Cross-signal intelligence | All of the above — in one platform with AI predictions |
